title: Building AI infrastructure with the Effingham County community
summary: OpenAI announces Project Camellia in Effingham County, Georgia, with commitments to responsible energy, community investment, jobs, and access to Codex.
body: OpenAI announces Project Camellia in Effingham County, Georgia, with commitments to responsible energy, community investment, jobs, and access to Codex.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布在佐治亚州埃芬ham县启动Project Camellia项目，致力于推动负责任的能源供应、社区投资、就业机会，并提供Codex等工具的访问权限，以建立长期可持续的AI基础设施。原始信息显示：OpenAI announces Project Camellia in Effingham County, Georgia, with commitments to responsible energy, community investment, jobs, and access to Codex.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Building AI infrastructure with the Effingham County community”。其重要性主要体现在：该文章报道了OpenAI在佐治亚州建设AI基础设施的计划，对能源供应和算力布局具有一定参考价值。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
